items.text: 49ers WR Deebo Samuel Sr. out for remainder of game due to hamstring injury.
items.implication: Remaining SF WRs/TEs see boost in leftover snaps; monitor severity for ROS.

items.text: Cardinals trading Marvin Harrison Jr. and 2027 7th to Texans for 2027 2nd and 6th. MHJ inactive today; fresh start with Stroud. Blockbuster confirmed with Schefter.
items.why: Deal finalized Sunday; MHJ sat while trade worked; reunites with CJ Stroud.
items.implication: ARI WR room opens (Michael Wilson etc elevated immediately); HOU adds long-term WR talent alongside Nico Collins.
items.opportunity: Immediate target bump for ARI remaining WRs; ROS upgrade path for MHJ in HOU.

items.text: FINAL UPDATE: Ashton Jeanty will play; Terry McLaurin will play. Projections updated.
items.why: Pregame workouts and final reports cleared both after GTD tags (Jeanty plantar/ankle; McLaurin).
items.implication: Jeanty retains lead back role for LV; McLaurin full go for WAS with Daniels returning.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty is a go after hopeful GTD (plantar fasciitis/ankle); worked out pregame. LV elevated RB in case.
items.why: Pregame confirmation after late-week missed practice.
items.implication: Lead RB role intact for Raiders.

items.text: Ja'Marr Chase and Tee Higgins will play vs Dolphins after being listed questionable.
items.why: Final weekend reports and updates confirm both Bengals WRs clear to play.
items.implication: Full CIN WR corps available; no major snap/target redistribution.

items.text: Justin Jefferson expected to play; Jordan Addison not expected to play. Later confirmed Jefferson active, Addison inactive.
items.why: Weekend reports upgraded Jefferson; Addison ruled out.
items.implication: Jefferson gets full workload in home state; Addison absence boosts other MIN pass-catchers short-term.
items.opportunity: Increased targets for remaining Vikings WRs/TEs with Addison out.

items.text: Jaylen Warren passes every test (advanced stats, eye test); Austin Ekeler-esque. Coaching staffs refused workhorse role including splitting with Rico Dowdle pre-injury. Insane with Dowdle out.
items.why: Dowdle out (not expected); Warren elite profile ignored previously.
items.implication: Strong RB2/flex with clear path to lead role and receiving work for PIT.
items.opportunity: Full snap/carry/route share expansion with Dowdle inactive.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey is active but not expected to play meaningful snaps (foot). Earlier not expected at all.
items.why: Did not practice; listed Q; confirmed limited role.
items.implication: Minimal fantasy impact expected; boosts other LAC WRs like Quentin Johnston if limited.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/routes for LAC secondary receivers.

items.text: Texans RB David Montgomery downgraded to out with groin injury.
items.implication: Increased role for HOU RBs behind or other backs.
items.opportunity: More carries for remaining Texans RBs.

items.text: George Kittle has illness but expected to play; officially active vs Seahawks.
items.why: Illness noted but cleared; confirmed active.

items.text: Caleb Williams officially inactive (hamstring); chance to play next week. Tyson Bagent starts.
items.why: Confirmed inactive; Rapoport notes next-week chance.
items.implication: Bears offense with backup QB; lower volume for CHI pass-catchers short-term.

items.text: Actives include Keenan Allen, Jaylen Wright, Terry McLaurin, Ashton Jeanty. Inactives: Caleb Williams, Jordan Addison.
items.implication: Clears multiple GTDs positively for fantasy starters.

items.text: NOT EXPECTED TO PLAY: Ladd McConkey, Caleb Williams, Rico Dowdle, Marvin Harrison Jr., Darius Slayton, Josh Palmer. GTD included Jefferson/Addison/Jeanty/McLaurin/DJ Moore. Expected: Flowers, Tate, Stevenson, Kamara, Keenan Allen.
items.why: Comprehensive Sunday AM compilation of weekend reports.
items.implication: Major role shifts: Warren elevated with Dowdle out; Bears backup QB; ARI without MHJ; LAC without full McConkey.
items.opportunity: Jaylen Warren workhorse potential; handcuffs and secondary WRs.

items.text: Zay Flowers expected to play (foot) then officially active vs Falcons SNF.
items.implication: Full go with Huntley at QB for BAL.

items.text: Marshawn Lloyd killing it on waiver wires everywhere.
items.why: Strong performance driving adds post-games or pre.
items.implication: Priority waiver add in GB backfield for depth/handcuff upside.
items.opportunity: Potential expanded role if injuries hit GB RBs.

items.text: Rain game totals dropping: CLE-NYJ 40 to 38.5; IND-PIT 43.5 to 42; NYG-WAS 44 to 41.5. Not all weather-related.
items.implication: Lower scoring environments; favor run/ground games, suppress pass volume.

items.text: Messiest injury week I can remember. Still no early info on Bengals WRs (later cleared); ton of GTDs; various docks on playing through injury. Projections live.
items.why: Multiple high-profile Q/GTD into Sunday AM.
items.implication: Volatile projections; last-minute livestream for digestion.

items.text: Chase Brown (The Brown Gobbler) gobbles targets and fantasy points; likes him a lot this week. Nickname push.
items.why: Target share and production; Week 5 Love list context.
items.implication: Strong start in CIN backfield especially with full WRs back.
